passages.title: 圖書館裡的橘貓
passages.text: Our town library has a special member: an orange cat named Mango. He came in from the rain three years ago and never left. Mango is very {1}. He never makes a sound, so he fits in well. Every morning, he walks {2} between the shelves, like he's checking the books. On weekends, the library gets very {3}, and children line up to pet him. Mango doesn't {4} being touched. He just lies on the reading table and closes his eyes. Last month, a little girl named Mia was afraid of reading aloud in class. Her mom brought her to the library to practice. Every day, Mia sat next to Mango and read him a story. The cat never laughed at her mistakes. After a month, Mia was {5} able to read in front of her whole class.

blanks.why: Mango is very quiet「Mango 很安靜」，後面說牠從不出聲。noisy（吵鬧的）和「從不出聲」矛盾；crowded（擁擠的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容這隻貓的特點。
walks slowly「慢慢地走」，像在檢查書一樣。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）都不能形容走路；loudly（大聲地）和「從不出聲」矛盾。
gets very crowded「變得很擁擠」，小朋友排隊摸牠。honest（誠實的）、thirsty（口渴的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容圖書館人很多。
doesn't mind + V-ing「不介意…」，牠不介意被摸。hope、decide、agree 後面都不能直接接 being touched。
finally「終於」，練習一個月後終於敢在全班面前朗讀。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能表示經過努力後的結果。

passages.zh: 我們鎮上的圖書館有一位特別的成員：一隻叫 Mango 的橘貓。三年前，牠為了躲雨跑進來，從此就沒有離開。Mango 非常安靜，從來不出聲，所以和圖書館很搭。每天早上，牠都在書架間慢慢地走，好像在檢查書一樣。到了週末，圖書館變得很擁擠，小朋友排隊等著摸牠。Mango 不介意被摸，牠只是躺在閱覽桌上，閉起眼睛。上個月，一個叫 Mia 的小女孩很怕在課堂上朗讀。她媽媽帶她來圖書館練習。每天，Mia 都坐在 Mango 旁邊讀故事給牠聽。這隻貓從不嘲笑她讀錯。一個月後，Mia 終於能在全班面前朗讀了。

passages.title: 跨年夜的捷運站
passages.text: On New Year's Eve, my friends and I went to see the fireworks at Taipei 101. After the show, we walked to the MRT station. It was so {1} that we could hardly move. Thousands of people were trying to go home at the same time, so the line moved very {2}. The station was also very {3}. People were laughing, shouting, and singing New Year songs. Then my friend Ken got lost in the crowd. We called him again and again, but he couldn't hear {4}. So we stopped calling. {5}, we sent him a message: "Meet us at Exit 3." Twenty minutes later, Ken found us there with a big smile. "Happy New Year!" he shouted. We got home at three in the morning, tired but happy.

blanks.why: so crowded that we could hardly move「擠到幾乎動不了」。quiet（安靜的）、honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不會讓人「動不了」。
moved very slowly「移動得很慢」，因為人太多。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容隊伍移動的速度。
very noisy「很吵」，後面說大家又笑又叫又唱歌。quiet（安靜的）和後句矛盾；thirsty（口渴的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容車站。
couldn't hear anything「什麼都聽不到」，否定句用 anything。nothing 已經是否定，不能和 couldn't 一起用；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 hear 的受詞。
Instead「改為、反而」，不打電話，改傳訊息。Ago（以前）要放在時間後面；Either（也不）用在否定句尾；Seldom（很少）不能表示「改用另一個方法」。

passages.zh: 跨年夜，我和朋友們去台北 101 看煙火。表演結束後，我們走到捷運站。那裡擠到我們幾乎動不了。成千上萬的人都想在同一時間回家，所以隊伍移動得非常慢。車站也很吵，大家又笑又叫，還在唱新年歌。這時，我的朋友 Ken 在人群中走散了。我們一直打電話給他，但他什麼都聽不到。所以我們不打了，改傳訊息給他：「在 3 號出口等。」二十分鐘後，Ken 在那裡找到我們，笑得很開心。「新年快樂！」他大喊。我們凌晨三點才到家，雖然很累，但是很開心。

passages.title: 新版龜兔賽跑
passages.text: Everyone knows the story of the rabbit and the turtle. But here is a new one. This time, the rabbit didn't sleep. He ran fast and won easily. The turtle walked {1} and came in last. The rabbit laughed at him, but the turtle didn't {2}. He just smiled. "Let's race again," he said, "but this time, I choose the road." The new road went across a river. The rabbit ran to the river and stopped. He couldn't swim, and there was {3} he could do. A few minutes later, the turtle arrived. {4} of passing the rabbit, he said, "Climb on my back." He swam across the river with the rabbit on his back. Then the rabbit carried the turtle and ran. Together, they {5} reached the finish line at the same time. They both learned that working together is better than winning alone.

blanks.why: walked slowly「慢慢地走」，所以最後一名。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能說明烏龜為什麼輸。
didn't mind「不介意」，被嘲笑也不在乎，只是笑一笑。borrow（借）、marry（嫁娶）、spell（拼字）單獨放在 didn't 後面都說不通。
there was nothing he could do「他什麼也不能做」。anything 不能用在肯定句 there was 後面；nobody（沒有人）、nowhere（無處）都不能當 do 的受詞。
Instead of + V-ing「不但沒有…反而…」，烏龜沒有超過兔子，反而叫牠爬上背。Ago、Either、Seldom 都沒有 ___ of 的用法。
finally reached「終於抵達」。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能修飾「抵達終點」。

passages.zh: 大家都知道龜兔賽跑的故事，但這裡有一個新版本。這一次，兔子沒有睡覺，牠跑得很快，輕鬆就贏了。烏龜慢慢地走，最後一名。兔子嘲笑牠，但烏龜不介意，只是笑了笑。「我們再比一次，」牠說，「但這次由我選路線。」新的路線要過一條河。兔子跑到河邊就停住了。牠不會游泳，什麼也做不了。幾分鐘後，烏龜到了。牠沒有超過兔子，反而說：「爬到我背上來。」牠背著兔子游過了河。接著換兔子背著烏龜跑。牠們一起終於同時抵達了終點線。牠們都學到了：合作比自己一個人贏更好。

passages.title: 端著蛋糕爬樓梯
passages.text: For Mom's fortieth birthday, Dad and I made a big chocolate cake. It took us the whole afternoon. When it was ready, I had to carry it up to the third floor, where Mom was waiting. Dad said, "Walk {1}. Don't drop it!" I held the cake with both hands and climbed the stairs {2}, one step at a time. Halfway up, our cat ran between my feet. I almost fell! {3}, the cake stayed in my hands. When I {4} got to the top, I opened the door and shouted, "Happy birthday!" Mom was so surprised that she said {5} for a few seconds. Then she laughed and cried at the same time. "This is the best present ever," she said. The cake was a little ugly, but it was delicious.

blanks.why: Walk carefully「小心地走」，後面說別把蛋糕摔了。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能說明端蛋糕要怎麼走。
climbed the stairs slowly「慢慢地爬樓梯」，一次一階。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容爬樓梯的方式。
Luckily「幸好」，差點跌倒，但蛋糕還在手上。Loudly（大聲地）、Brightly（明亮地）、Heavily（沉重地）都說不通。
finally got to the top「終於到了樓上」。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能修飾「到達」。
said nothing「什麼也沒說」，驚訝到說不出話。anything 不能用在肯定句 she said 後面；nobody（沒有人）、nowhere（無處）都不能當 said 的受詞。

passages.zh: 媽媽四十歲生日時，爸爸和我做了一個大巧克力蛋糕，花了我們一整個下午。蛋糕做好後，我得把它端到三樓，媽媽在那裡等著。爸爸說：「小心走，別摔了！」我用兩手捧著蛋糕，一階一階慢慢地爬樓梯。爬到一半，我們家的貓從我腳邊跑過去，我差點跌倒！幸好蛋糕還好好地在我手上。我終於爬到樓上，打開門大喊：「生日快樂！」媽媽驚訝得好幾秒說不出話來。接著她又哭又笑。「這是我收過最棒的禮物，」她說。蛋糕有點醜，但很好吃。

passages.title: 樓上的鼓聲
passages.text: Our new upstairs neighbor plays the drums. Every night at ten, the boom-boom-boom starts. It was so {1} that I couldn't sleep. Dad wanted to go upstairs and shout at him, but Mom said no. {2}, she baked some cookies and took them upstairs with me. The neighbor was a college student named Leo. He opened the door and looked worried. Mom smiled and asked him {3}, "Would you {4} not playing after nine?" Leo's face turned pink. "I'm so sorry," he said. "I didn't know the walls were so thin." The next night, there was no sound at ten. The building was {5} again, and I slept well. On Saturday, Leo even invited us to his band's show. He played the drums, and this time, we enjoyed every beat.

blanks.why: so noisy that I couldn't sleep「吵到我睡不著」。quiet（安靜的）和睡不著矛盾；crowded（擁擠的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容鼓聲。
Instead「反而、改為」，媽媽不讓爸爸去吼，改烤餅乾上樓。Ago（以前）要放在時間後面；Either（也不）用在否定句尾；Seldom（很少）不能表示改用另一種做法。
asked him politely「有禮貌地問他」，媽媽是微笑著問的。cheaply（便宜地）、hungrily（飢餓地）、heavily（沉重地）都不能形容說話的態度。
Would you mind + V-ing「你介意…嗎」，客氣的請求。hope、decide、agree 後面都不能直接接 not playing。
The building was quiet again「大樓又安靜了」，前一句說十點沒有聲音。crowded（擁擠的）、thirsty（口渴的）、honest（誠實的）都不能說明沒有鼓聲。

passages.zh: 我們樓上的新鄰居會打鼓。每天晚上十點，「咚咚咚」的聲音就開始了。吵到我睡不著。爸爸想上樓去罵他，但媽媽說不行。她反而烤了一些餅乾，帶著我一起拿上樓。鄰居是一位叫 Leo 的大學生。他開門時一臉擔心。媽媽微笑著有禮貌地問他：「你介意九點以後不要打鼓嗎？」Leo 的臉紅了。「真的很抱歉，」他說，「我不知道牆壁這麼薄。」隔天晚上十點，一點聲音都沒有，大樓又恢復了安靜，我睡得很好。星期六，Leo 甚至邀請我們去看他樂團的表演。他在台上打鼓，這一次，我們每一拍都聽得很享受。

passages.title: 選高中的煩惱
passages.text: Choosing a high school was hard for me. My parents wanted me to go to a school near home, but my teacher said I should try a famous school in Taipei. I couldn't make up my {1}. Every day, I changed my plan. At night, I lay in bed and thought about it, but {2} helped. Then my grandpa said, "Don't think about what others want. What do you love?" I {3} the cooking class I took last summer. It was the happiest week of my life! I searched online and found a school in Taoyuan with a great cooking program. I {4} knew what I wanted. When I told my parents, they were {5} for a minute. Then Dad smiled and said, "If that's your dream, go for it."

blanks.why: make up my mind「下定決心」，固定片語。pocket（口袋）、garbage（垃圾）、headache（頭痛）都不能和 make up my 搭配。
nothing helped「什麼都沒有幫助」，想了也沒用。anything 不能當肯定句的主詞；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當主詞。
remembered the cooking class「想起那堂烹飪課」。borrowed（借）、married（嫁娶）、spelled（拼字）都不能接「去年夏天上的課」。
finally knew「終於知道」自己要什麼。cheaply（便宜地）、heavily（沉重地）、loudly（大聲地）都不能修飾 knew。
they were quiet for a minute「他們沉默了一分鐘」，接著爸爸才開口。crowded（擁擠的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容人的反應。

passages.zh: 選高中對我來說很難。爸媽希望我讀家裡附近的學校，但老師說我應該試試台北一所有名的學校。我一直下不了決心，每天都在改變計畫。晚上我躺在床上想，但怎麼想都沒用。後來爺爺說：「不要想別人要什麼。你喜歡什麼？」我想起去年夏天上的烹飪課，那是我這輩子最快樂的一個星期！我上網搜尋，找到桃園一所有很棒的餐飲科的學校。我終於知道自己想要什麼了。我告訴爸媽的時候，他們沉默了一分鐘。接著爸爸笑著說：「如果那是你的夢想，就放手去做吧。」

passages.title: 排了兩小時的雲霄飛車
passages.text: Last Sunday, my cousins and I went to an amusement park. It was a holiday, so the park was very {1}. We wanted to ride the new roller coaster, but the line was two hours long. The line moved {2}, and everyone was hot and tired. My little cousin kept asking, "Are we there yet?" We had {3} to do, so we played word games. After two hours, it was {4} our turn. We sat down, and the ride started. We screamed all the way down, and my cousin's cap flew off his head. Then, suddenly, the ride stopped. It lasted only ninety seconds! "Two hours for ninety seconds?" my cousin said. "Next time, let's come on a weekday {5}."

blanks.why: very crowded「很擁擠」，因為是假日；後面說排隊要兩小時。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能形容遊樂園人多。
moved slowly「移動得很慢」。honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）、cheaply（便宜地）都不能形容隊伍前進的速度。
had nothing to do「沒事可做」，所以玩文字遊戲。anything 不能用在肯定句 We had 後面；nobody（沒有人）、nowhere（無處）都不能接 to do 表示「沒事可做」。
it was finally our turn「終於輪到我們」。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、heavily（沉重地）都說不通。
come on a weekday instead「改成平日來」，instead 放句尾表示「改為」。ago 要接在時間後面；either 用在否定句；seldom（很少）不能放句尾。

passages.zh: 上星期天，我和表兄弟姊妹去遊樂園。因為是假日，園區非常擁擠。我們想坐新的雲霄飛車，但排隊要兩個小時。隊伍移動得很慢，大家又熱又累。小表弟一直問：「到了沒？」我們沒事可做，就玩起文字遊戲。兩個小時後，終於輪到我們了。我們坐好，雲霄飛車開動了，我們一路尖叫衝下去，表弟的帽子還被吹飛了。接著，它突然就停了，只有九十秒！「排兩個小時坐九十秒？」表弟說，「下次我們改成平日來吧。」

passages.title: 半夜廚房的怪聲
passages.text: Late one night, I woke up because I heard a strange sound in the kitchen. Everyone else was asleep, and the house was very {1}. I got out of bed and walked {2} to the kitchen. I turned on the light, but I saw {3}. Then the sound came again. It was coming from the cabinet under the sink! I opened the door {4}. Two shining eyes looked at me. It was our cat, Oreo! She had found a bag of fish snacks and was eating them happily. I laughed so hard that Mom woke up and came downstairs. "What's going on?" she asked. When she saw Oreo, she shook her head and said, "Never {5}. Let's all go back to bed."

blanks.why: the house was very quiet「房子裡很安靜」，因為大家都睡了。thirsty（口渴的）、honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容房子。
walked carefully「小心地走」，半夜聽到怪聲要小心。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容走路的方式。
saw nothing「什麼都沒看到」。anything 不能用在肯定句 I saw 後面；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 saw 的受詞。
opened the door slowly「慢慢地打開門」，因為不知道裡面是什麼。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容開門的方式。
Never mind「算了、沒關係」，固定用語。pocket（口袋）、garbage（垃圾）、headache（頭痛）都不能和 Never 搭配。

passages.zh: 有一天深夜，我被廚房裡奇怪的聲音吵醒。其他人都睡了，房子裡非常安靜。我下床小心地走到廚房。我打開燈，但什麼都沒看到。接著聲音又出現了，是從水槽下面的櫃子傳來的！我慢慢地打開櫃門，兩隻發亮的眼睛盯著我看。原來是我們家的貓 Oreo！牠找到一包魚乾零食，正吃得很開心。我笑得太大聲，把媽媽吵醒了，她走下樓來。「怎麼了？」她問。看到 Oreo，她搖搖頭說：「算了，大家都回去睡覺吧。」

passages.title: 姊姊吃素的一個月
passages.text: Last month, my sister watched a movie about farm animals and decided to stop eating meat. "I'll eat beans and vegetables {1}," she said. Mom was worried. "Will you get enough energy?" she asked. So my sister read about it {2} and made a healthy plan. At first, it was hard. When Dad cooked his famous beef noodles, she wanted them so much. But she didn't eat {3} with meat for a whole month. She also learned to cook tofu in many different ways. Her spicy tofu was so {4} that even Dad asked for more. At the end of the month, Dad asked her, "Would you {5} cooking dinner for us every Sunday?" My sister laughed and said yes. Now our family eats no meat one day a week.

blanks.why: eat beans and vegetables instead「改吃豆類和蔬菜」，instead 放句尾表示「代替」。ago 要接在時間後面；either 用在否定句；seldom（很少）不能放句尾。
read about it carefully「仔細地讀相關資料」，才做出健康的計畫。cheaply（便宜地）、heavily（沉重地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容讀資料的方式。
didn't eat anything「什麼都沒吃」，否定句用 anything。nothing 已經是否定，不能和 didn't 一起用；nobody（沒有人）、nowhere（無處）都不能當 eat 的受詞。
so delicious that…「好吃到連爸爸都要再來一份」。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、brave（勇敢的）都是形容人，不能形容食物。
Would you mind + V-ing「你介意…嗎」，客氣的請求。hope、decide、agree 後面都不能直接接 cooking。

passages.zh: 上個月，姊姊看了一部關於家畜的電影，決定不再吃肉。「我改吃豆類和蔬菜，」她說。媽媽很擔心：「這樣妳會有足夠的體力嗎？」於是姊姊仔細讀了相關資料，做了一份健康的計畫。一開始很辛苦，爸爸煮他拿手的牛肉麵時，她好想吃。但她一整個月都沒吃任何有肉的東西。她也學會用很多不同的方法煮豆腐。她做的麻辣豆腐好吃到連爸爸都要再來一碗。月底的時候，爸爸問她：「妳介意每個星期天煮晚餐給我們吃嗎？」姊姊笑著答應了。現在我們家每個星期有一天不吃肉。

passages.title: 魔女琪琪的送貨任務
passages.text: Kiki is a young witch who delivers things on her broom. One morning, a baker asked her to deliver a birthday cake to a boy across the city. "Fly {1}," the baker said. "The party starts at noon." The city streets were {2} with cars, so flying was faster than driving. But the wind was strong that day. Kiki held the box tightly and flew {3} between the tall buildings. Suddenly, a big bird flew right at her! She turned quickly, and the box almost fell. {4}, she caught it just in time. At 11:55, she {5} arrived at the boy's house. The cake was perfect. The boy smiled and said, "Thank you, witch girl!" Kiki flew home with a happy heart. It was a hard day, but she loved her job.

blanks.why: Fly carefully「小心地飛」，因為帶著蛋糕。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容飛行的方式。
crowded with cars「擠滿了車」，所以用飛的比較快。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能接 with cars 形容街道。
flew slowly「慢慢地飛」，風很大，要穩穩地飛。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容飛行的速度。
Luckily「幸好」，箱子差點掉下去，但及時接住了。Loudly（大聲地）、Brightly（明亮地）、Heavily（沉重地）都說不通。
finally arrived「終於抵達」，在派對前五分鐘趕到。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能修飾抵達。

passages.zh: 琪琪是一個騎著掃帚送貨的小魔女。有一天早上，一位麵包師傅請她把一個生日蛋糕送到城市另一頭的一個男孩家。「要小心飛喔，」麵包師傅說，「派對中午開始。」城裡的街道擠滿了車，所以用飛的比開車快。但那天風很大，琪琪緊緊抱著盒子，在高樓之間慢慢地飛。突然，一隻大鳥朝她直衝過來！她趕快轉彎，盒子差點掉下去。幸好她及時接住了。十一點五十五分，她終於抵達男孩家。蛋糕完好無缺。男孩笑著說：「謝謝妳，魔女姊姊！」琪琪開開心心地飛回家。雖然這一天很辛苦，但她很愛她的工作。

passages.title: 搭船去小琉球
passages.text: Last summer, my family took a ferry to Xiaoliuqiu. The ferry was {1} with tourists, and we had to stand for the whole trip. The sea was rough, and the boat went up and down. My little brother felt sick. He sat on the floor and said {2} for twenty minutes. Mom gave him some water and told him to look at the sky. After half an hour, we {3} got to the island. My brother felt better as soon as his feet touched the ground. In the afternoon, we went snorkeling. The water was clear and {4}, and we saw three big sea turtles eating sea plants. One of them swam {5} right next to me. It didn't seem to be afraid at all. My brother said, "The boat ride was terrible, but this was worth it!"

blanks.why: crowded with tourists「擠滿了遊客」，所以只能站著。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能接 with tourists 形容船上的情況。
said nothing「一句話也沒說」，因為暈船。anything 不能用在肯定句 he said 後面；nobody（沒有人）、nowhere（無處）都不能當 said 的受詞。
finally got to the island「終於抵達小島」。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能修飾抵達。
clear and quiet「清澈又平靜」，形容海水。crowded（擁擠的）、honest（誠實的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能形容海水。
swam slowly「慢慢地游」，好像一點也不怕人。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容海龜游泳的樣子。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家搭渡輪去小琉球。渡輪上擠滿了遊客，我們整趟都只能站著。海浪很大，船一直上上下下。弟弟暈船了，他坐在地上，二十分鐘一句話都沒說。媽媽給他喝點水，叫他看著天空。半小時後，我們終於到了小島。弟弟的腳一踩到地面就好多了。下午我們去浮潛，海水清澈又平靜，我們看到三隻大海龜在吃海草。其中一隻就在我旁邊慢慢地游，好像一點也不怕人。弟弟說：「坐船很可怕，但這一切都值得！」

passages.title: 雨後的蝸牛賽跑
passages.text: After a rainy morning, my little sister and I found many snails in our garden. "Let's have a snail race!" she said. We drew a start line and a finish line on the ground with chalk. Then we picked up two snails {1} and put them at the start. My sister named hers Rocket, and I named mine Lightning. Of course, they moved very {2}. After five minutes, Rocket had gone only ten centimeters. Lightning didn't move at all. "Is he sleeping?" my sister asked. I didn't {3} losing, but I wanted to see Lightning move. So we waited and waited. Our garden was so {4} that we could hear the raindrops falling from the leaves. After half an hour, Rocket {5} crossed the finish line. My sister jumped up and shouted, "We won!" Then we put both snails back under the plants.

blanks.why: picked up two snails carefully「小心地把兩隻蝸牛拿起來」，以免傷到牠們。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容拿起蝸牛的方式。
moved very slowly「動得很慢」，蝸牛本來就很慢。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容移動速度。
didn't mind losing「不介意輸」，mind 後面接 V-ing。hope、decide、agree 後面都不能直接接 losing。
so quiet that we could hear the raindrops「安靜到聽得見雨滴聲」。crowded（擁擠的）、honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容花園安靜。
finally crossed the finish line「終於越過終點線」，等了半小時。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都說不通。

passages.zh: 一個下雨的早上過後，我和妹妹在院子裡發現了很多蝸牛。「我們來辦蝸牛賽跑！」她說。我們用粉筆在地上畫了起點線和終點線，然後小心地拿起兩隻蝸牛，放在起點。妹妹把她的取名為「火箭」，我的叫「閃電」。當然，牠們爬得非常慢。五分鐘後，火箭只前進了十公分，閃電則完全不動。「牠在睡覺嗎？」妹妹問。我不介意輸，但我很想看閃電動一下。於是我們等了又等。院子裡安靜到我們聽得見雨滴從葉子上落下的聲音。半小時後，火箭終於越過了終點線。妹妹跳起來大叫：「我們贏了！」然後我們把兩隻蝸牛都放回植物底下。

passages.title: 第一次捏陶
passages.text: Last Saturday, Mom took me to a pottery class in Yingge. Our teacher, Mr. Chen, showed us how to make a cup on a spinning wheel. He made it look easy. But when I tried, the clay flew everywhere. "Don't press so hard," Mr. Chen said. "Move your hands {1}." I tried again. This time, I held the clay {2} with both hands. Little by little, it became a cup! It wasn't perfect, but I was proud of it. Then Mom's clay fell off the wheel and broke into pieces. She had {3} left to work with. Mr. Chen gave her some more clay, and she laughed and said, "I'll make a plate {4}." Two weeks later, our cup and plate were {5} ready. My cup is a little crooked, but I drink milk from it every morning.

blanks.why: Move your hands slowly「手慢慢地移動」，前一句叫我不要太用力。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容手的動作。
held the clay carefully「小心地捧著陶土」。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容捧陶土的方式。
had nothing left「什麼都沒剩下」，陶土都碎了。anything 不能用在肯定句 She had 後面；nobody（沒有人）、nowhere（無處）都不能表示沒有陶土可用。
make a plate instead「改做一個盤子」，instead 放句尾表示「改為」。ago 要接在時間後面；either 用在否定句；seldom（很少）不能放句尾。
were finally ready「終於做好了」，等了兩個星期。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都說不通。

passages.zh: 上星期六，媽媽帶我去鶯歌上陶藝課。陳老師示範怎麼用拉坯機做杯子，他做起來看似很簡單。但輪到我的時候，陶土飛得到處都是。「不要壓那麼用力，」陳老師說，「手要慢慢地動。」我再試了一次，這次我用兩手小心地捧著陶土。慢慢地，它變成了一個杯子！雖然不完美，但我很自豪。這時，媽媽的陶土從拉坯機上掉下來，摔成碎片，她什麼都沒得用了。陳老師又給她一些陶土，她笑著說：「那我改做一個盤子好了。」兩個星期後，我們的杯子和盤子終於燒好了。我的杯子有點歪，但我每天早上都用它喝牛奶。

passages.title: 隱形斗篷
passages.text: One day, a young wizard named Leo found an old cloak in his grandpa's attic. When he put it on, he couldn't see his own body. It was a cloak that made people invisible! The next morning, he walked into the classroom {1} in the cloak. Nobody saw him. He sat in the back and listened to his classmates talk. Then he heard his friend Sam say, "I hope Leo is okay. He's not here today." Leo felt {2}. His friends were worried about him, but he couldn't say {3} because he was afraid of scaring them. So he walked out of the room {4}, took off the cloak, and came back in. "Leo! You're here!" Sam said with a big smile. That night, Leo put the cloak back in the attic. He decided to spend his time with his friends {5}. Being seen, he thought, was much better than being invisible.

blanks.why: walked in quietly「安靜地走進去」，穿著隱形斗篷不想被發現。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容偷偷走進教室的樣子。
felt terrible「覺得很難過、過意不去」，朋友在擔心他。polite（有禮貌的）、honest（誠實的）、crowded（擁擠的）都不能表示他聽到這句話的感受。
couldn't say anything「什麼都不能說」，否定句用 anything。nothing 已經是否定，不能和 couldn't 一起用；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 say 的受詞。
walked out carefully「小心地走出去」，以免被發現。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容走路的方式。
spend his time with his friends instead「改把時間花在朋友身上」，不再用斗篷。ago 要接在時間後面；either 用在否定句；seldom（很少）不能放句尾。

passages.zh: 有一天，一個叫 Leo 的小巫師在爺爺家的閣樓裡找到一件舊斗篷。他一穿上，就看不到自己的身體了。原來這是一件能讓人隱形的斗篷！隔天早上，他穿著斗篷，安靜地走進教室，沒有人看見他。他坐在最後面，聽同學們聊天。接著他聽到朋友 Sam 說：「希望 Leo 沒事，他今天沒來。」Leo 覺得很過意不去。朋友們在擔心他，但他怕嚇到大家，什麼都不能說。於是他小心地走出教室，脫下斗篷，再走回來。「Leo！你來了！」Sam 笑得好開心。那天晚上，Leo 把斗篷放回閣樓。他決定改把時間花在朋友身上。他想，被大家看見，比隱形好太多了。

passages.title: 空盒子裡的禮物
passages.text: On my birthday, my best friend Nina gave me a big box with a red ribbon. I opened it {1} because I wanted to enjoy the moment. But when I looked inside, there was {2} in it! I didn't know what to say. "Is this a joke?" I asked. Nina laughed. "Look again," she said. "Look {3} at the bottom." There was a small card at the bottom of the box. It said, "This box is full of time. Every Sunday this month, I'll spend the whole afternoon with you. We can do {4} you want." I was so happy. Nina is always busy with her piano lessons, so this was the best present she could give me. That month, we went biking, baked cookies, and watched movies. I {5} understood that time with friends is the greatest gift.

blanks.why: opened it slowly「慢慢地打開」，想好好享受那一刻。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容拆禮物的方式。
there was nothing in it「裡面什麼都沒有」，所以我不知道該說什麼。anything 不能用在肯定句 there was 後面；nobody（沒有人）、nowhere（無處）都不能形容盒子裡空空的。
Look carefully「仔細看」，底部有一張小卡片。cheaply（便宜地）、heavily（沉重地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容看的方式。
do anything you want「做任何你想做的事」，肯定句中的 anything 表示「任何事」。nothing 意思相反；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 do 的受詞。
finally understood「終於明白」。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能修飾 understood 表示經過這個月才明白。

passages.zh: 我生日那天，最好的朋友 Nina 送我一個綁著紅緞帶的大盒子。我慢慢地打開，因為我想好好享受這一刻。但往裡面一看，什麼都沒有！我不知道該說什麼。「這是在開玩笑嗎？」我問。Nina 笑了：「再看一次，仔細看看底部。」盒子底部有一張小卡片，上面寫著：「這個盒子裡裝滿了時間。這個月的每個星期天，我都會陪你一整個下午，你想做什麼都可以。」我好開心。Nina 總是忙著上鋼琴課，所以這是她能給我的最好的禮物。那個月，我們一起騎腳踏車、烤餅乾、看電影。我終於明白，和朋友在一起的時間才是最棒的禮物。

passages.title: 阿公的助聽器
passages.text: My grandpa can't hear well. When we talk to him, we have to shout, and he still often says, "What?" Last year, my dad bought him a hearing aid, but Grandpa didn't want to wear it. "It makes everything too {1}," he said. "I can hear the cars, the dogs, and even the fridge!" So the hearing aid stayed in a drawer. Then one day, my little cousin was born. When Grandpa held the baby, she made small sounds, but he couldn't hear {2}. He looked sad. That night, he {3} took the hearing aid out of the drawer. The next day, he held the baby again. This time, he heard her soft laugh. His eyes filled with tears. "I didn't {4} missing the noise of the cars," he said, "but I don't want to miss this." Now he wears it every day, and our dinners aren't {5} anymore. Grandpa joins every talk!

blanks.why: too noisy「太吵了」，他聽得到車聲、狗叫，連冰箱聲都聽得到。quiet（安靜的）和後句矛盾；honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容聲音。
couldn't hear anything「什麼都聽不到」，否定句用 anything。nothing 已經是否定，不能和 couldn't 一起用；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 hear 的受詞。
finally took it out「終於把它拿出來」，為了聽孫女的聲音。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能表示他終於改變主意。
didn't mind missing…「不介意聽不到…」，mind 後面接 V-ing。hope、decide、agree 後面都不能直接接 missing。
aren't quiet anymore「不再安靜了」，因為阿公加入每個話題。crowded（擁擠的）、honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能和「阿公加入聊天」形成因果。

passages.zh: 我阿公聽力不好。我們跟他說話都得用喊的，他還是常常說：「什麼？」去年，爸爸買了一副助聽器給他，可是阿公不想戴。「它讓什麼都變得好吵，」他說，「我聽得到車子、狗，連冰箱的聲音都聽得到！」所以助聽器一直放在抽屜裡。後來有一天，我的小表妹出生了。阿公抱著寶寶的時候，她發出小小的聲音，但他什麼都聽不到，看起來很難過。那天晚上，他終於把助聽器從抽屜裡拿了出來。隔天，他再抱寶寶時，聽到了她輕輕的笑聲，眼眶都濕了。「聽不到車子的吵鬧聲我不介意，」他說，「但我不想錯過這個。」現在他每天都戴著助聽器，我們的晚餐也不再安靜了，阿公每個話題都要參一腳！

passages.title: 掃地機器人和貓
passages.text: Last month, we bought a robot vacuum. It moves {1} around the house and cleans the floor by itself. Mom loves it, but our cat, Tofu, hates it. The first time the robot started, it was so {2} that Tofu jumped onto the bookshelf and stayed there for an hour. The next day, Tofu tried to fight it. He hit it with his paw, but the robot did {3}. It just kept cleaning. After a week, Tofu changed his plan. {4} of fighting the robot, he started riding on it! Now every afternoon, he sits on top of the robot and goes around the living room like a king. When the robot stops, Tofu gets off and walks away, as if {5} happened. My dad made a video of it, and it got ten thousand views online.

blanks.why: moves slowly「慢慢地移動」。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容機器人移動的樣子。
so noisy that Tofu jumped onto the bookshelf「吵到 Tofu 跳上書架」。quiet（安靜的）和「嚇得跳上書架」矛盾；honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容機器。
did nothing「什麼反應都沒有」，只是繼續打掃。anything 不能用在肯定句 did 後面；nobody（沒有人）、nowhere（無處）都不能當 did 的受詞。
Instead of + V-ing「不再…而改…」，不打機器人，改坐在上面。Ago、Either、Seldom 都沒有 ___ of 的用法。
as if nothing happened「好像什麼事都沒發生」。anything 不能當肯定句的主詞；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 happened 的主詞。

passages.zh: 上個月，我們買了一台掃地機器人。它會在家裡慢慢地移動，自己把地板掃乾淨。媽媽很喜歡它，但我們的貓「豆腐」很討厭它。機器人第一次啟動的時候，吵到豆腐跳上書架，待了一個小時才下來。隔天，豆腐想跟它打架。牠用腳掌打它，但機器人一點反應也沒有，只是繼續打掃。一個星期後，豆腐改變了計畫：牠不再跟機器人打架，而是開始坐在上面！現在每天下午，牠都坐在機器人上，像國王一樣在客廳裡繞來繞去。機器人一停，豆腐就跳下來走開，好像什麼事都沒發生過。爸爸把這拍成影片，網路上有一萬人次觀看。

passages.title: 考試時腦袋一片空白
passages.text: Last week, we had a big math test. I studied hard for three days, so I felt ready. But when I looked at the first question, my {1} went blank. I couldn't remember {2}! The classroom was so {3} that I could hear my heart beating. I looked at the clock. Twenty minutes had passed, and I had written {4}. Then I remembered what my teacher always says: "If you get stuck, close your eyes and breathe." So I closed my eyes and took three deep breaths. When I opened them, I read the question again. This time, I saw a word I knew. One step at a time, the answers came back to me. I {5} finished the test just before the bell rang. I got 82. It wasn't my best grade, but I learned how to stay calm.

blanks.why: my mind went blank「腦袋一片空白」，固定說法。pocket（口袋）、garbage（垃圾）、uniform（制服）都不能表示想不起來。
couldn't remember anything「什麼都想不起來」，否定句用 anything。nothing 已經是否定，不能和 couldn't 一起用；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 remember 的受詞。
so quiet that I could hear my heart「安靜到聽得見心跳」。crowded（擁擠的）、honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容教室安靜。
had written nothing「一個字都還沒寫」。anything 不能用在肯定句 I had written 後面；nobody（沒有人）、nowhere（無處）都不能當 written 的受詞。
finally finished「終於寫完」，在鐘響前完成。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都說不通。

passages.zh: 上星期我們有一場很重要的數學考試。我認真讀了三天，覺得自己準備好了。可是一看到第一題，我的腦袋就一片空白，什麼都想不起來！教室安靜到我聽得見自己的心跳。我看了看時鐘，二十分鐘過去了，我一個字都還沒寫。這時我想起老師常說的話：「如果卡住了，就閉上眼睛深呼吸。」於是我閉上眼睛，深呼吸三次。再睜開眼睛時，我重新讀了一遍題目，這次我看到一個我會的詞。一步一步地，答案慢慢回來了。我終於在鐘響前寫完考卷。我考了 82 分，雖然不是我最好的成績，但我學會了怎麼保持冷靜。

passages.title: 搭貓空纜車
passages.text: On Sunday, my family took the Maokong Gondola to the tea farms in the mountains. The station was very {1}, and we waited in line for forty minutes. We {2} got into a car with a glass floor. When it started to move, I could see the trees right under my feet! My little brother held onto Dad's arm and didn't look down. The car moved {3} up the mountain, so we had plenty of time to enjoy the view. We could see Taipei 101 far away. At the top, it was cool and {4}. There was no traffic, only birds singing in the trees. We drank tea and ate tea-flavored ice cream. "It's so much better than the noisy city," Mom said. On the way down, my brother was {5} enough to look through the glass floor. "This isn't scary at all," he said, but he was still holding Dad's hand.

blanks.why: very crowded「很擁擠」，排隊排了四十分鐘。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能形容車站人多。
finally got into a car「終於坐上車廂」，排了很久。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都說不通。
moved slowly up the mountain「慢慢地往山上移動」，所以有很多時間看風景。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容纜車移動。
cool and quiet「涼爽又安靜」，後面說沒有車聲，只有鳥叫。noisy（吵鬧的）和後句矛盾；thirsty（口渴的）、honest（誠實的）都不能形容山上的環境。
brave enough to look「勇敢到敢往下看」，去程他都不敢往下看。polite（有禮貌的）、honest（誠實的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能接 enough to look 表示「敢」。

passages.zh: 星期天，我們全家搭貓空纜車去山上的茶園。車站非常擁擠，我們排了四十分鐘的隊，終於坐上一台有玻璃地板的車廂。纜車一開始移動，我就看到樹木就在我的腳下！弟弟緊抓著爸爸的手臂，不敢往下看。纜車慢慢地往山上移動，所以我們有很多時間欣賞風景，還能看到遠方的台北 101。山上涼爽又安靜，沒有車聲，只有鳥兒在樹上唱歌。我們喝了茶，還吃了茶口味的冰淇淋。「這裡比吵鬧的城市好太多了，」媽媽說。回程時，弟弟鼓起勇氣往玻璃地板下看。「一點都不可怕嘛，」他說，但他還是牽著爸爸的手。

passages.title: 柯南與消失的金錶
passages.text: One rainy afternoon, Mr. Wang's gold watch went missing from his house. The police looked around, but they found {1} useful. Then Conan, the boy detective, arrived. He walked around the living room {2} and looked at every corner. Near the open window, he found some small, muddy footprints on the floor. "Did anyone come in today?" Conan asked. "No," said Mr. Wang. "It was {3} all afternoon. I was reading in my room." Conan went out to the garden and looked up at a big tree. There was a crow's nest in it, and something inside was shining. It was the gold watch! Everything {4} made sense. "Crows love shiny things," Conan said. "The bird flew in through the window and took it. The footprints are the crow's!" Mr. Wang laughed. {5} of locking his doors, he now closes his windows before he reads.

blanks.why: found nothing useful「沒找到任何有用的東西」。anything 不能用在肯定句 they found 後面；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 found 的受詞。
walked around carefully「仔細地四處走」，每個角落都看。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容偵探查看的方式。
It was quiet all afternoon「整個下午都很安靜」，沒有人進來。thirsty（口渴的）、honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容下午的情況。
Everything finally made sense「一切終於說得通了」。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能修飾 made sense。
Instead of + V-ing「不是…而是…」，他不是去鎖門，而是看書前先關窗。Ago、Either、Seldom 都沒有 ___ of 的用法。

passages.zh: 一個下雨的午後，王先生的金錶從家裡不見了。警察四處查看，卻沒找到任何有用的線索。這時，少年偵探柯南來了。他在客廳裡仔細地走了一圈，每個角落都不放過。在開著的窗戶旁邊，他發現地上有一些小小的泥巴腳印。「今天有人進來過嗎？」柯南問。「沒有，」王先生說，「整個下午都很安靜，我一直在房間看書。」柯南走到院子，抬頭看著一棵大樹。樹上有一個烏鴉巢，裡面有東西在發亮——就是那支金錶！一切終於說得通了。「烏鴉很喜歡閃亮的東西，」柯南說，「是這隻鳥從窗戶飛進來把錶叼走的，那些腳印是烏鴉的！」王先生笑了。他沒有因此去鎖門，而是現在看書前都會先把窗戶關好。

passages.title: 冰雪城堡裡的姊姊
passages.text: After Elsa ran away to the mountains, she built a castle of ice. It was beautiful, but it was also very {1}. No one came, and no one made a sound. For days, Elsa had {2} to do. She just walked around the empty rooms. Then one morning, her sister Anna climbed all the way up the mountain. "Please come home," Anna said. Elsa stepped back. "I can't control my power," she said. "I might hurt you." {3} of leaving, Anna walked closer and held her sister's cold hands. "I don't {4} the cold," she said. "I just want my sister back." Elsa looked at Anna and began to cry. Her heart {5} became warm, and the snow around them started to melt. Then, hand in hand, the two sisters walked down the mountain together.

blanks.why: very quiet「很安靜」，後面說沒人來、沒有任何聲音。noisy（吵鬧的）、crowded（擁擠的）都和後句矛盾；honest（誠實的）不能形容城堡。
had nothing to do「沒事可做」，只能在空房間裡走來走去。anything 不能用在肯定句 had 後面；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能接 to do 表示「沒事做」。
Instead of + V-ing「不但沒有…反而…」，安娜沒有離開，反而走近握住姊姊的手。Ago、Either、Seldom 都沒有 ___ of 的用法。
I don't mind the cold「我不在乎冷」，mind 可直接接名詞。hope、decide、agree 都不能直接接 the cold 表示「不在乎」。
slowly became warm「慢慢地變溫暖」，雪也開始融化。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容心變暖的過程。

passages.zh: 艾莎逃到山上後，用冰蓋了一座城堡。城堡很美，卻也非常安靜，沒有人來，也沒有一點聲音。好幾天，艾莎都沒事可做，只是在空蕩蕩的房間裡走來走去。後來有一天早上，她的妹妹安娜一路爬上了山。「請跟我回家，」安娜說。艾莎往後退：「我控制不了我的力量，我可能會傷害妳。」安娜不但沒有離開，反而走上前，握住姊姊冰冷的手。「我不在乎冷，」她說，「我只想要我的姊姊回來。」艾莎看著安娜，哭了起來。她的心慢慢地變得溫暖，周圍的雪也開始融化。接著，姊妹倆手牽著手，一起走下山。

passages.title: 運動會的大隊接力
passages.text: Our school sports day is always {1}. Students shout, drums beat, and music plays all day. The most exciting event is the relay race. This year, our class made it to the final. Students stood all around the track, and the seats were {2} with parents. I was the last runner. When the baton came to me, we were in third place. I took it {3} because I didn't want to drop it. Then I ran as fast as I could. I passed one runner, then another. My legs hurt, but I didn't stop. I {4} crossed the finish line first! My classmates ran to me and lifted me up. Our teacher, who is usually very serious, couldn't say {5}. She just cried and hugged us all.

blanks.why: always noisy「總是很吵」，後面說大家喊叫、打鼓、放音樂。quiet（安靜的）和後句矛盾；honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容運動會。
crowded with parents「擠滿了家長」。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能接 with parents 形容座位區。
took it carefully「小心地接過來」，怕掉棒。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容接棒的方式。
finally crossed the finish line first「終於第一個衝過終點」。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都說不通。
couldn't say anything「什麼都說不出來」，否定句用 anything。nothing 已經是否定，不能和 couldn't 一起用；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 say 的受詞。

passages.zh: 我們學校的運動會總是很吵，學生大聲喊叫、鼓聲咚咚、音樂從早放到晚。最刺激的項目是大隊接力。今年，我們班打進了決賽。跑道四周站滿了學生，看台上擠滿了家長。我是最後一棒。接力棒傳到我手上時，我們是第三名。我小心地接過棒子，因為我不想掉棒。接著我用最快的速度往前衝，超過了一個人，又超過一個。我的腿好痛，但我沒有停。我終於第一個衝過終點線！同學們衝過來把我抬起來。我們平常很嚴肅的老師一句話也說不出來，只是哭著抱住我們每一個人。

passages.title: 和外婆包粽子
passages.text: Every year before the Dragon Boat Festival, my grandma makes zongzi. This year, she let me help her. First, she showed me how to fold the bamboo leaves into a cone. "Do it {1}," she said. "If you go too fast, the leaves will break." Then we put rice, pork, mushrooms, and an egg yolk inside. I added the rice {2} so {3} would fall out. Tying the string was the hardest part. My first zongzi looked like a ball, and my second one fell apart. Grandma didn't {4}. "My first one looked even worse," she laughed. After two hours, we {5} had fifty zongzi. We boiled them in a big pot, and the whole house smelled wonderful. My ugly zongzi tasted just as good as Grandma's.

blanks.why: Do it slowly「慢慢做」，後面說太快葉子會破。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容摺葉子的方式。
added the rice carefully「小心地放米」。cheaply（便宜地）、heavily（沉重地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容放米的方式。
so nothing would fall out「這樣就不會有東西掉出來」。anything 不能當肯定句的主詞；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 would fall out 的主詞。
didn't mind「不介意」，外婆笑著說她第一顆更醜。borrow（借）、marry（嫁娶）、spell（拼字）單獨放在 didn't 後面都說不通。
finally had fifty zongzi「終於包好五十顆粽子」。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都說不通。

passages.zh: 每年端午節前，外婆都會包粽子。今年她讓我幫忙。首先，她教我怎麼把竹葉摺成圓錐形。「慢慢來，」她說，「太快的話，葉子會破掉。」接著我們放進米、豬肉、香菇和一顆蛋黃。我小心地放米，這樣才不會有東西掉出來。綁繩子是最難的部分。我包的第一顆粽子像一顆球，第二顆直接散開了。外婆一點也不介意，她笑著說：「我第一顆包得更醜呢。」兩個小時後，我們終於包好了五十顆粽子。我們把粽子放進大鍋裡煮，整間房子都好香。我包的醜粽子吃起來和外婆包的一樣好吃。

passages.title: 夜晚的動物園
passages.text: Last Friday, our class went to the zoo at night. Most visitors come in the daytime, so at night, the zoo was dark and {1}. Our guide told us to walk {2} and turn off our flashlights. "Many animals sleep in the day and wake up at night," she said. First, we saw a pangolin looking for ants. Then we heard a strange sound from the trees. It was so {3} that my friend covered her ears. It was a group of monkeys calling to each other! Next, we went to see the owls. In the dark, I couldn't see {4} at first. But after a few minutes, my eyes got used to the dark, and I {5} saw a big owl on a branch. It turned its head and looked right at me. It was the coolest field trip ever.

blanks.why: dark and quiet「又暗又安靜」，因為大部分遊客白天來。crowded（擁擠的）和前句矛盾；honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容動物園。
walk slowly「慢慢地走」，以免吵到動物。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容走路的方式。
so noisy that my friend covered her ears「吵到朋友摀住耳朵」。quiet（安靜的）和後句矛盾；honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容聲音。
couldn't see anything「什麼都看不見」，否定句用 anything。nothing 已經是否定，不能和 couldn't 一起用；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 see 的受詞。
finally saw「終於看到」，眼睛習慣黑暗之後。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都說不通。

passages.zh: 上星期五，我們班晚上去動物園。大部分遊客都是白天來，所以晚上的動物園又暗又安靜。導覽員要我們慢慢走，並把手電筒關掉。「很多動物白天睡覺，晚上才醒來，」她說。我們先看到一隻穿山甲在找螞蟻。接著，樹上傳來一陣奇怪的聲音，吵到我的朋友摀住了耳朵。原來是一群猴子在互相呼叫！然後我們去看貓頭鷹。在黑暗中，我一開始什麼都看不見。但過了幾分鐘，眼睛習慣了黑暗，我終於看到一隻大貓頭鷹站在樹枝上。牠轉過頭，直直地看著我。這是我參加過最酷的校外教學。

passages.title: 爸爸的驚喜派對
passages.text: We planned a surprise party for Dad's fiftieth birthday. For two weeks, my sister and I kept {1} about it. Whenever Dad asked what we were doing, we just said, "{2}!" On Saturday, Mom took Dad out for lunch. While they were gone, we decorated the living room and invited his friends. Soon, the living room was {3} with people, balloons, and food. Twenty people hid behind the sofa and the curtains in the dark and waited without making a sound. When Dad {4} opened the door, we turned on the lights and shouted, "Surprise!" Dad was so shocked that he couldn't say {5}. Then he started to laugh. Later, he told us, "I knew something was going on. You two were much too quiet this month!"

blanks.why: kept quiet about it「對這件事保密、不說出去」，keep quiet 是固定用法。crowded（擁擠的）、honest（誠實的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能表示保守祕密。
"Nothing!"「沒事！」，回答「你們在做什麼」。Anything 不能這樣單獨回答表示「沒做什麼」；Nowhere（無處）回答「去哪裡」；Ever（曾經）不能單獨回答。
crowded with people「擠滿了人」。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能接 with people, balloons, and food 形容客廳。
finally opened the door「終於開門進來」，大家已經躲著等了。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都說不通。
couldn't say anything「什麼都說不出來」，否定句用 anything。nothing 已經是否定，不能和 couldn't 一起用；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 say 的受詞。

passages.zh: 我們為爸爸的五十歲生日計畫了一個驚喜派對。兩個星期以來，我和姊姊都守口如瓶。每次爸爸問我們在做什麼，我們只說：「沒事！」星期六，媽媽帶爸爸出去吃午餐。他們出門的時候，我們布置了客廳，也邀請了爸爸的朋友。很快地，客廳就擠滿了人、氣球和食物。二十個人躲在黑暗中的沙發和窗簾後面，一點聲音都不敢出地等著。爸爸終於打開門的時候，我們打開燈大喊：「驚喜！」爸爸震驚得說不出話來，接著就笑了出來。後來他告訴我們：「我就知道有事。你們兩個這個月實在太安靜了！」

passages.title: 和舅舅單車環島
passages.text: Last summer, my uncle and I rode our bikes around Taiwan. It took us ten days. On the first day, I rode too fast and got tired by noon. My uncle said, "Ride {1} at first. We have a long way to go." On the third day, it rained hard on a mountain road in Pingtung. We had to ride very {2} because the road was wet. On the fifth day, my bike got a flat tire far from any town. {3}, a kind farmer drove us to a bike shop in his truck. In Hualien, my uncle wanted to stay in a hotel, but I wanted to try camping on the beach {4}. We slept under the stars and listened to the waves all night. On the tenth day, we {5} rode back into Taipei. My legs were sore, but my heart was full.

blanks.why: Ride slowly「騎慢一點」，因為路還很長。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容騎車的速度。
ride very carefully「騎得非常小心」，因為路面濕滑。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容雨天騎車的方式。
Luckily「幸好」，有好心的農夫載我們去修車。Loudly（大聲地）、Brightly（明亮地）、Heavily（沉重地）都說不通。
try camping on the beach instead「改試試在海灘露營」，instead 放句尾表示「改為」。ago 要接在時間後面；either 用在否定句；seldom（很少）不能放句尾。
finally rode back into Taipei「終於騎回台北」，騎了十天。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都說不通。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，舅舅和我騎腳踏車環島，花了十天。第一天，我騎太快，中午就累了。舅舅說：「一開始騎慢一點，我們還有很長的路要走。」第三天，屏東的山路上下起大雨，路面很濕，我們得非常小心地騎。第五天，我的腳踏車在離城鎮很遠的地方爆胎了。幸好一位好心的農夫用卡車載我們到腳踏車店。到了花蓮，舅舅想住飯店，但我想改試試在海灘露營。我們睡在星空下，聽了一整晚的海浪聲。第十天，我們終於騎回了台北。我的腿很痠，但心裡滿滿的。

passages.title: 一個人在家的週末
passages.text: My parents went to Tainan for a wedding, and I stayed home alone for the weekend. At first, I was very excited. I could eat {1} I wanted and play games all night! But on Saturday night, the house felt too {2}. Every little sound scared me. I usually get angry at my little brother because he is so {3}, but now I missed his loud voice. I tried to cook dinner, but I burned the noodles. In the end, I ate cookies {4}. On Sunday, I cleaned the whole house and waited by the window. When my family {5} came home that evening, I ran to the door and hugged my brother. He looked surprised. "Are you okay?" he asked. I just laughed. I didn't tell him how much I had missed him.

blanks.why: eat anything I wanted「想吃什麼就吃什麼」，肯定句中的 anything 表示「任何東西」。nothing 和「很興奮」的語意相反；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 eat 的受詞。
felt too quiet「感覺太安靜了」，只有我一個人在家。crowded（擁擠的）和「一個人在家」矛盾；honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容房子。
he is so noisy「他很吵」，後面說想念他的大嗓門。quiet（安靜的）和「大嗓門」矛盾；honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不會讓人生氣。
ate cookies instead「改吃餅乾」，因為麵煮焦了。ago 要接在時間後面；either 用在否定句；seldom（很少）不能放句尾。
finally came home「終於回到家」，我等了一整天。honestly（誠實地）、cheaply（便宜地）、politely（有禮貌地）都說不通。

passages.zh: 爸媽去台南參加婚禮，我一個人在家過週末。一開始我很興奮，我想吃什麼就吃什麼，還可以整晚打電動！但到了星期六晚上，家裡感覺太安靜了，一點小聲音都會嚇到我。我平常總是對弟弟生氣，因為他很吵，可是現在我卻想念他的大嗓門。我想煮晚餐，結果把麵煮焦了，最後只好改吃餅乾。星期天，我把整間房子打掃乾淨，在窗邊等著。傍晚家人終於回到家時，我跑到門口抱住弟弟。他一臉驚訝：「你還好吧？」他問。我只是笑一笑，沒有告訴他我有多想他。

passages.title: 第一次鋼琴比賽
passages.text: Last month, I played the piano in a competition. The hall was big and {1}. Nobody made a sound. When it was my turn, my hands were shaking. I walked {2} to the piano and sat down. I remembered what my teacher had told me: "Don't think about winning. Just clear your {3} and enjoy the music." I took a deep breath and started to play. I played the first part {4}, and then I forgot about all the people. I only heard the music. When I finished, nobody did {5} for a second. Then everyone started clapping. I didn't win first place, but I got third. My teacher hugged me and said, "I heard your heart in the music today. That's more important than any prize."

blanks.why: big and quiet「又大又安靜」，後面說沒有人出聲。noisy（吵鬧的）和後句矛盾；honest（誠實的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不能形容演奏廳。
walked slowly「慢慢地走」，因為很緊張。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容走路的方式。
clear your mind「放空腦袋」，不要想輸贏。pocket（口袋）、garbage（垃圾）、uniform（制服）都和「不要想太多」無關。
played carefully「小心地彈」，一開始彈得很謹慎。cheaply（便宜地）、heavily（沉重地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容彈琴的方式。
nobody did anything「沒有人有任何動作」，nobody 已是否定，後面用 anything。nothing 會變成雙重否定；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能當 did 的受詞。

passages.zh: 上個月，我參加了一場鋼琴比賽。演奏廳又大又安靜，沒有人發出一點聲音。輪到我的時候，我的手在發抖。我慢慢地走到鋼琴前坐下。我想起老師對我說過的話：「不要想輸贏，放空腦袋，好好享受音樂。」我深吸一口氣，開始彈奏。一開始我彈得很小心，後來我就忘了台下所有的人，只聽得見音樂。彈完時，有一秒鐘大家都沒有任何動作，接著全場響起掌聲。我沒有得第一名，但得了第三名。老師抱著我說：「今天我在音樂裡聽到了你的心，這比任何獎都重要。」

passages.title: 雲林外婆家的夏天
passages.text: Every summer, I stay at my grandma's house in the countryside of Yunlin. My home in Taipei is always {1} with cars and motorcycles. But Grandma's village is very {2}. There are only a few houses, and at night, the only sound is the frogs. Life there moves {3}. People walk to the market and stop to talk with every neighbor on the way. Every morning, Grandma wakes me up at five to feed the chickens. In Taipei, I would never get up so early, but here I don't {4}. {5} of playing on my phone, I ride my bike along the rice fields and catch fish in the river with my cousins. Every time I go back to the city, I miss the frogs and Grandma's cooking.

blanks.why: noisy with cars and motorcycles「汽機車的聲音很吵」。quiet（安靜的）和「汽機車」矛盾；honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容家裡的環境。
very quiet「很安靜」，晚上只有青蛙叫。crowded（擁擠的）和「只有幾間房子」矛盾；honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容村子。
moves slowly「步調很慢」，大家走路去市場，還停下來和鄰居聊天。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、politely（有禮貌地）都不能形容生活步調。
I don't mind「我不介意」，在這裡早起也沒關係。hope、decide、agree 單獨放在 don't 後面，都不能表示「不介意早起」。
Instead of + V-ing「不…而改…」，不玩手機，改去騎腳踏車。Ago、Either、Seldom 都沒有 ___ of 的用法。

passages.zh: 每年暑假，我都會住在雲林鄉下的外婆家。我在台北的家總是充滿汽機車的吵鬧聲，但外婆住的村子非常安靜，只有幾戶人家，晚上唯一的聲音就是青蛙叫。那裡的生活步調很慢，大家走路去市場，一路上還會停下來和每個鄰居聊天。每天早上五點，外婆都會叫我起床餵雞。在台北，我絕對不會這麼早起，但在這裡我一點也不介意。我不玩手機，而是和表兄弟姊妹沿著稻田騎腳踏車，到河裡抓魚。每次回到城市，我都會想念青蛙和外婆煮的菜。

passages.title: 家裡的新成員
passages.text: My baby brother, Ethan, was born last month. Since then, our home has changed a lot. When he sleeps, everyone must be {1}. I can't play music or watch TV loudly. When I walk past his room, I walk {2} so the floor doesn't make a sound. But when Ethan wakes up, he is very {3}. He cries so loudly that our neighbors can hear him! At first, I felt a little left out. Mom and Dad were so busy that they didn't have time for {4} else. Then one day, Mom put Ethan in my arms. He looked up at me and held my finger with his tiny hand. At that moment, I didn't {5} the crying or the noise anymore. Now I sing to him every night, and he always falls asleep before the song ends.

blanks.why: everyone must be quiet「大家都要安靜」，寶寶在睡覺。crowded（擁擠的）、honest（誠實的）、thirsty（口渴的）都不是寶寶睡覺時的要求。
walk carefully「小心地走」，讓地板不發出聲音。cheaply（便宜地）、honestly（誠實地）、hungrily（飢餓地）都不能形容走路的方式。
very noisy「很吵」，後面說他哭到鄰居都聽得到。quiet（安靜的）和後句矛盾；honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容嬰兒哭鬧。
didn't have time for anything else「沒有時間做其他任何事」，否定句用 anything。nothing 已經是否定，不能和 didn't 一起用；nowhere（無處）、ever（曾經）都不能接在 for 後面。
didn't mind the crying「不在意他的哭聲」。borrow（借）、marry（嫁娶）、spell（拼字）都不能接 the crying or the noise。

passages.zh: 我的弟弟 Ethan 上個月出生了。從那時起，我們家改變了很多。他睡覺的時候，每個人都得安靜。我不能大聲放音樂或看電視。走過他房間時，我都小心地走，讓地板不發出聲音。可是 Ethan 一醒來就很吵，哭聲大到鄰居都聽得到！一開始，我覺得有點被冷落。爸媽忙到沒有時間做其他任何事。後來有一天，媽媽把 Ethan 放進我懷裡。他抬頭看著我，用小小的手握住我的手指。那一刻，我再也不在意他的哭聲和吵鬧了。現在我每天晚上都唱歌給他聽，他總是在歌還沒唱完前就睡著了。
